title: #97 – Sertac Karaman: Robots That Fly and Robots That Drive
summary: Sertac Karaman is a professor at MIT, co-founder of the autonomous vehicle company Optimus Ride, and is one of top roboticists in the world, including robots that drive and robots that fly.
